Straightforward by design

How you’re protected.

No fine-print tricks. Here is exactly how Mobile Mechanic Network looks out for vehicle owners.

  • Your address stays privateWe never require your street address to request a quote. Mechanics see only your city, state, and ZIP. Once a job is booked, you or your mechanic may add the repair location to the job ticket.
  • You compare before you commitYou compare real quotes from mobile mechanics before committing to anything. Nothing is booked until you choose.
  • Reviews come from real jobsReviews come only from paid jobs, so the ratings you read reflect work that actually happened.
  • No platform markup, everYou pay your mechanic directly, and the platform never marks up the price. The quote you accept is the mechanic’s own price.
  • Free for vehicle ownersThe platform is free for vehicle owners — finding mobile mechanics, comparing quotes, and booking costs you nothing.
  • No account needed to get quotesRequest quotes as a guest, no account required. A free account just saves your vehicles and keeps your repair history in one place.
  • Extra work needs your approval firstThe price you accept never changes without your approval. If extra work comes up, nothing joins your invoice without your approval, and anything you decline is never charged.
  • Set prices on some profilesSome mechanics list a set price for a service on their profile, so you can see the price before you request.

A garage that remembers

Your vehicle’s history shouldn’t live in a glove box.

Vehicle owners get a simple home for service records and repair details. Know what was done, when it happened and who completed the work.

Pre-purchase inspection

Know what you're buying before you buy it.

Thinking of buying a car? Have a mobile mechanic near you perform a pre-purchase inspection and understand exactly what you are getting into.

This is not a decision to buy or not buy. It is a clear, honest template showing what concerns the vehicle is presenting now, or may present soon.

  • ✓ Tire tread depth, measured per tire
  • ✓ Brake inspection: pads, rotors, lines
  • ✓ Computer scan of all modules
  • ✓ Current fluid leaks
  • ✓ Belt condition
  • ✓ Oil level and fluid checks
  • ✓ Suspension, battery, lights, cooling, exhaust
  • ✓ Exterior, body and interior

Every item is rated Good, Needs attention, or Fail, with notes and a timeline: monitor it, repair it soon, or fix it now. The mechanic sends you a link to your full report.

Complete vehicle inspection

Know what's coming before it breaks down.

A complete vehicle inspection is a routine checkout by a mobile mechanic at your home or workplace. It helps you stay informed about your vehicle, keep up with maintenance, and catch concerns before they become major issues or breakdowns.

This is the inspection for the vehicle you already own.

When to get one

  • ✓ Routinely — a regular checkout to stay ahead of wear and small problems.
  • ✓ Before a major trip — know your vehicle is ready for the road.
  • ✓ To stay on top of maintenance — see what is due, what can wait, and what needs attention now.
  • ✓ For peace of mind — a clear picture of your vehicle's condition, in writing.

What gets checked

  • ✓ Tires and wheels, measured per tire
  • ✓ Brakes: pads, rotors, lines
  • ✓ All fluids: oil, coolant, brake, steering, transmission, washer
  • ✓ Belts and hoses
  • ✓ Battery and charging
  • ✓ Engine and leaks
  • ✓ Transmission and drivetrain
  • ✓ Suspension and steering
  • ✓ Exhaust system
  • ✓ Cooling system
  • ✓ Lights and electrical
  • ✓ Wipers, glass, and mirrors
  • ✓ Climate, cabin, and safety
  • ✓ Computer scan
  • ✓ Road test

Every item is rated Good, Needs attention, or Fail, with notes and a timeline: monitor it, repair it soon, or fix it now. The mechanic sends you a link to your full report, which you can print or share.

Fair Price Guide

Start with a researched range, not a guess.

Understand what goes into a repair price and set expectations before requesting a quote—not to dispute the price a mobile mechanic sets for your specific vehicle.

A mobile mechanic is not always the lowest-cost option, but is always the most convenient: professional service at your home or workplace, with no towing and no waiting room.

Full-synthetic oil change

These national ranges cover mainstream sedans and light SUVs. Oil capacity and required specification can move the price.

Market context · not a quote

Planning baseline only. These are not guaranteed repair costs. Actual prices vary by area, parts supplier, travel distance, your specific vehicle, and the situation. Your mobile mechanic’s quote is the final, authoritative price.

Independent shop$70–$120Published national range
Corporate franchise$80–$135
Dealership$90–$150Estimated from dealer labor and parts markup

Mobile mechanics are not listed here on purpose: every mobile mechanic on the network sets their own price for your vehicle and your job, and their quote is the price that counts.

Parts & labor

Parts are about $45–$70; labor is typically 0.5–1.0 hour.

Vehicle effect

No compact-specific numeric adjustment was published; oil capacity and required specification matter.

Every vehicle is different—your mobile mechanic’s quote reflects your specific vehicle, parts quality, location, access, and situation. A $50–$120 diagnostic or trip fee may apply and is often credited toward the repair. Independent shop labor rates start at $125–$165 per hour, and dealership labor rates can run higher. This guide is market context to set expectations, not a quote or a tool to dispute one. Mobile mechanics always set their own final price.

The essentials

Questions, answered.

How do I add Mobile Mechanic Network to my phone’s home screen?

On iPhone, open Mobile Mechanic Network in Safari, tap the Share button, then choose “Add to Home Screen.” On Android, open it in Chrome, tap the menu, then choose “Add to Home screen” or “Install app.”

Who is Mobile Mechanic Network for?

It is for vehicle owners who want a clearer repair experience: find a mobile mechanic near you, compare quotes, and keep every repair organized in one place.

Does Mobile Mechanic Network employ the mobile mechanics?

No. The marketplace helps independent mobile mechanics present their own services, rates and availability. Each professional operates their own business.

What can vehicle owners keep track of?

Your garage connects repair requests, estimates, invoices, receipts and service history to the right vehicle.

Where is Mobile Mechanic Network available?

Mobile Mechanic Network is available for nationwide coverage across all 50 states, with availability expanding as independent mobile mechanics join the network.

What is a complete vehicle inspection?

A complete vehicle inspection by a mobile mechanic at your home or workplace. It helps you stay informed about vehicle concerns before they become major issues or breakdowns, keep up with your vehicle's routine maintenance, and get your vehicle checked before a major trip. You get a written report, category by category, that you can print or share.

Privacy Policy

Mobile Mechanic Network

Last updated: October 20, 2026

  1. What we collect

    Account information you provide (name, email, phone number, password), vehicles you save, quote requests (vehicle, service, description, location), mechanic business profiles (business name, service areas, services, pricing, photos, social links), quotes, tickets, reviews, and help requests.

  2. How we use it

    To run the marketplace: matching quote requests with mechanics, showing business profiles in the directory, sending quote and job updates by text and email, and improving the service. We do not sell your personal information.

  3. What is public

    Mechanic business profiles, promotions, and reviews are public in the directory. We never require your street address to request a quote. Mechanics you request quotes from see your name, phone number, vehicle, job details, and general area (city, state, ZIP). Once a job is booked, you or your mechanic may add the repair location to the job ticket so the mechanic knows where to go.

  4. Texts and emails

    Mechanics get texts about new requests and customer contact. Vehicle owners get texts and emails about estimates, invoices, job completion, and payment. Message and data rates may apply.

  5. Security

    Passwords are stored hashed, never in plain text. No system is perfectly secure, but we work to protect your information.

  6. Your choices

    You can update your account information at any time, and you can ask us to delete your account by emailing us.

  7. Questions

    For privacy questions, email Mobilemechanicsnetwork@gmail.com.
